rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Registration name: JACorflo
Exhibition name: Light My Fire™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, 2008).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins (Wholesale) in 2009 as 'Light My Fire'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red. None to mild fragrance. Average diameter 4". Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, compact, rounded. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 30" (up to 75cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden.
